subject: Mobile Development
title: Keychain and Secure Storage
description: One-minute skill: Keychain and Secure Storage.

hook.text: Your phone stores passwords, tokens, and biometric data. Where does it keep them safe?

buildup.text: iOS Keychain and Android Keystore encrypt sensitive data using hardware-backed security.

discovery.text: A dedicated security chip stores encryption keys. Even the OS can't read them directly.

twist.text: Many apps store passwords in plain text instead of the keychain. It's alarmingly common.

climax.text: Secure storage hardware is available on every modern phone — developers just need to use it.

punchline.text: Your phone has a vault; not all apps use it.

quiz.question: What backs the security of iOS Keychain?
